author: Shoto_
body:
I have a few ideas for this kit, you all choose which one is better.

---option 1---
Random kit is basically a kit that chooses 3 mystery items to add extra challenge to gameplay, or either make it easy.
You can't get potions, but you can get pickaxes, food, ore, etc.
/kit random, I spawn with 1 diamond, a steak, and a wooden log.
Unlocked at level 13
---option 2---
A kit is slected at random for you, out of all the kits you currently have.
Unlocked at level 6
